preconditions: Complete and review all five DEV meetings on the final shared source identities.
Set the final BILLING_BOUNDS.json values without enabling paid execution outside the separately authorized workflow.
Set HOLD_OUT_GATE.json frozen=true as the Director's final gate value before manifest generation.
Do not inspect HOLDOUT outcomes before the command succeeds.

effects: Builds a pre-pin capsule while allowing only PIN_MANIFEST.json to be absent in this preparation mode.
Generates canonical experiments/psem_r2_policy/PIN_MANIFEST.json by hashing the actual capsule runtime copies and required HOLDOUT inputs.
Builds a new capsule containing canonical RUNTIME_PIN.json and PIN_MANIFEST.json through the ordinary config overlay.
Runs holdout_unlock_error in a fresh process rooted at that final capsule and exits nonzero unless the complete manifest matches actual capsule bytes.

repeat_validation.expected: Exit 0 with runtime_archive.verified=true and a manifest overlay containing both experiments/psem_r2_policy/RUNTIME_PIN.json and experiments/psem_r2_policy/PIN_MANIFEST.json.

failure_semantics: Any missing required source/config/test/override/input, changed archive/prompt/runtime pin, mismatched actual capsule copy, or noncanonical interpreter exits nonzero before HOLDOUT unlock.
